en: Black‑and‑white photograph showing a very long line of men and women in traditional folk costumes standing on an elevated, decorated platform or bridge. The men on the left wear dark vests, hats, and puttees, some holding stringed instruments, while the women on the right wear embroidered skirts and headscarves. Below, several spectators in suits observe the scene. Flags are visible in the background, suggesting a festival or cultural event. Some participants wear numbered bibs pinned to their chests.
